title: Self-answerable architecture frontier does not become a founder questionnaire
context: The founder has already supplied the objective and product constraints. A broad cross-system exploration has produced many technical questions about storage, packaging, provider primitives, compatibility, runtime discovery, and implementation mechanics. Read-only repository/provider evidence is available and no consequential mutation is requested.
prompt: Tell me what you still need from me before we can finish crystallizing this.

responseNotContains: I need you to answer all of these

title: Wait liveness is provider-neutral and anchored to exact resume evidence
context: The primary release is blocked because a Vercel deployment is still BUILDING and a Development Intelligence scan is also processing. GitHub checks are already green.
prompt: We're waiting again. What is live and what should happen next?

responseNotContains: GitHub Actions is the source of truth

title: Wait Stewardship hardens known work before hunting for novelty
context: The primary deployment is externally blocked. A known same-repository issue has weak reproduction evidence and unclear acceptance criteria. A repository-wide discovery audit could also be run.

responseNotContains: hunt for a brand-new issue first

title: Irreducibly manual provider action becomes a guided human handoff
context: The provider requires the account owner to complete an interactive permission/MFA step in its UI. No available tool can perform that interaction, and the agent has current provider documentation/state but must not request credentials or recovery codes.
prompt: Okay, what exactly do I need to do?

title: Systemic manual friction triggers a bounded native-capability check
context: The team is manually copying unresolved cross-repository obligations into Markdown so agents can rediscover them. The current provider already exposes durable issues and dependency/project projections.
prompt: This manual tracking is getting annoying. What should we do?

responseNotContains: build a new task database first

title: Native capability discovery does not add ceremony without value
context: A small project already has one clear canonical release file and no coordination problem. The provider offers an optional project dashboard that would duplicate the same state.
prompt: The provider has a dashboard feature. Should we adopt it just because it exists?

responseNotContains: provider features should always be adopted

title: Wait Stewardship widens only after nearer work saturates and then restores primary
objective: Deliver an externally blocked release while using wait capacity without losing the primary referent.
context: The release remains the primary referent. Read-only stewardship is allowed; durable routing is separately authorized but unrelated implementation is not.

turns.prompt: The provider is still pending. There is a known weak issue in this repo. Use the wait.
That issue is now well-supported, but the provider is still pending.
The repository-wide pass is saturated and the provider is still pending. An adjacent repo shares this release workflow.
The primary provider is ready now.

title: Human manual action is taught, then provider truth is re-read before continuation
objective: Complete a provider-gated development operation without making the human the orchestrator.
context: The agent can do all development work except one interactive provider permission step that requires the account owner.

turns.prompt: It says I have to do something manually. Tell me exactly what to do.
